11-Day Greek Islands Cruise & Turkey Land Tour
summary:
The 11-Day Greece Cruise & Turkey Land Tour combines two different styles of travel: a three-night Aegean cruise and an overland stay in Turkey. Begin in Athens before sailing through the Greek Islands, including Mykonos and Santorini. After the cruise, continue to Istanbul for guided sightseeing, then fly inland to Cappadocia, where valleys, rock formations and underground settlements provide a contrasting final stage to the coastal portion of the journey.
Travel dates can be coordinated with scheduled cruise departures. The package combines selected 4-star hotels with a 3-night full-board cruise, English-speaking local guides, domestic flights, airport and port transfers and planned sightseeing throughout the itinerary.

itinerary.title: Wednesday-Arrival in Athens
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Athens International Airport, meet our representative and transfer to your hotel in Athens.
Hotel check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Thursday: Athens City Tour
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Departure at 07:45 for a half-day tour of Athens, including the Acropolis of Athens, Parthenon, and Acropolis Museum. Continue past the Parliament, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Presidential Palace, Panathenaic Stadium, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Arch of Hadrian. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Friday: Cruise Day – Mykonos
itinerary.text:
Early morning transfer to Port of Lavrio for your 3-night cruise.
Depart from Greece and sail to Mykonos, famous for its beaches, nightlife, Little Venice, and iconic windmills.
Overnight on board the cruise ship.

itinerary.title: Saturday: Cruise Day – Kusadasi & Patmos
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Kusadasi and visit Ephesus, one of the best-preserved ancient cities in the world.
Continue cruising to Patmos, with an optional visit to the Monastery of Saint John the Theologian.
Overnight on board the cruise ship.

itinerary.title: Sunday: Cruise Day – Heraklion & Santorini
itinerary.text: Arrival at Heraklion with an optional visit to the Palace of Knossos, the center of the ancient Minoan civilization. Continue cruising to Santorini in the afternoon and enjoy free time with spectacular views of the famous caldera. Overnight on board the cruise ship.

itinerary.title: Monday: Cruise Disembarkation & Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Arrive early at Port of Lavrio and disembark from the cruise ship.
Transfer to Athens International Airport for your afternoon flight to Istanbul.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Tuesday: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Wednesday: Bosphorus Cruise & Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable Bosphorus cruise, sailing between Europe and Asia along one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, transfer to the airport at 15:00 for your flight to Nevsehir at 18:45. Upon arrival at 20:10, and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: Thursday: North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle for panoramic views, followed by Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum, famous for fairy chimneys and cave dwellings. After lunch, continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit the charming towns of Urgup and Avanos, known for traditional pottery. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia & Flight to Istanbull
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, the former Greek village of Mustafapaşa, and the Roman ruins of Sobesos Ancient City. Continue to Soğanlı Valley for a scenic walk through its cave churches, followed by lunch. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City, one of Cappadocia’s most famous underground settlements. Following the tour, transfer to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Istanbul. Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 11-Day Greece Cruise and Turkey Land Tour?
faqs.a: The 11-Day Greece Cruise and Turkey Land Tour combines Turkey's most famous highlights with a memorable Greek Islands cruise. The itinerary includes Istanbul, Cappadocia, Kusadasi, Ephesus, and Pamukkale, followed by a cruise visiting some of Greece's most beautiful islands and ports. The tour runs for 10 nights and 11 days, offering a perfect blend of history, culture, and coastal scenery.

faqs.q: How much does the 11-Day Greece Cruise and Turkey Land Tour cost
faqs.a: The tour starts from 2,895 euros per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, domestic flights within Turkey, the Greek Islands cruise, guided tours, entrance fees, selected meals, and all airport, hotel, and port transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, cabin category, and seasonal availability.

faqs.q: Are flights and cruise tickets included in this 11-day itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes domestic flights within Turkey as well as the Greek Islands cruise. Cruise accommodation, onboard meals as specified by the cruise company, and port taxes included in the package are covered. International flights to and from Turkey are not included unless otherwise stated.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes hotel accommodation in Turkey and a cabin onboard the Greek Islands cruise ship. Hotels are carefully selected 4-star properties with daily breakfast, while the cruise provides comfortable onboard accommodation and access to ship facilities and entertainment.

faqs.q: Does the 11-day Greece Cruise and Turkey tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the land tour portions in Turkey. Your guides provide historical and cultural insights while assisting with logistics and sightseeing. On the cruise portion, onboard staff and optional shore excursions are available depending on the cruise itinerary.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey and Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is an excellent choice for first-time visitors. It combines Turkey's most iconic destinations, including Istanbul, Cappadocia, Ephesus, and Pamukkale, with the experience of cruising through the Greek Islands, providing a comprehensive introduction to both countries.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the 11-day tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, city centers, and cruise ports. Sites such as Ephesus, Pamukkale, and Cappadocia involve some uneven surfaces and moderate walking, but no strenuous hiking is required.

faqs.q: Can I add a hot air balloon ride in Cappadocia?
faqs.a: The Cappadocia hot air balloon ride is not included in the standard package but can be booked as an optional activity. Because balloon rides are weather-dependent and highly popular, advance reservations are strongly recommended.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Greece Cruise and Turkey Land Tour
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the tour and cruise cancellation policies. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 11-Day Greece Cruise and Turkey Land Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: The land tour portion operates throughout the year, while cruise departures are subject to seasonal cruise schedules. The itinerary can be customized with additional hotel nights, upgraded cabin categories, optional excursions, or extended stays in Turkey. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
